name: Novalinq ELD
tagline: Hours-of-service compliance dashboard for US trucking fleets
role: ELD web dashboard and PDF service by the Softwhere team

scenes.title: Daily HOS by driver
scenes.body: Pick a driver to see daily miles, violations and remaining break, drive, shift and cycle time.

scenes.title: The 24-hour log grid
scenes.body: ELD events become the log graph, plus an event list and the signed log form.

scenes.title: Edit logs on the chart
scenes.body: Click an event to drag its start and end, switch its status or insert a new duty status.

scenes.title: The day's log as a PDF
scenes.body: A Puppeteer microservice renders the daily log to PDF and stores it on S3 for preview or download.

scenes.title: IFTA reports on demand
scenes.body: Choose a period, optionally count empty miles, and the fleet's IFTA report is generated as a PDF.
